# nomatron_role_assignment (Resource)

Nomatron role assignment resource. Note: the current SDK does not expose a role-assignment read/list endpoint, so Terraform cannot verify remote drift for this resource during refresh.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Note: the current SDK does not expose a role-assignment read/list endpoint,
// so Terraform cannot fully verify remote drift for this resource during refresh.
resource "nomatron_role_assignment" "example" {
  subject = "user:aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
  role    = "viewer"
  domain  = "global"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Role domain or scope, such as global or organization:<uuid>.
- `role` (String) Role name to assign.
- `subject` (String) Assignment subject, typically in the form user:<uuid> or service-account:<uuid>.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable composite identifier for the role assignment.
